# Publication information
## Michelle C. Agne, Robert A. Slesak, Constance A. Harrington, Beth A. Roskilly, Kristen L. Chadwick, Melissa Fischer
## Assisted population migration of Douglas-fir using operational transfer guidelines has limited risk to tree health
## Ecological Applications
### In review / revision

# Purpose and methods
This script runs the analyses of past (2015) foliage disease effects on tree survival in the 2024 survey. Findings are shown in Figure 6 and Appendix Tables S9 and S10.

We performed two separate analyses to assess Swiss Needle Cast (SNC) and Rhabocline effects separately. We subsetted the data used in each analysis set following methods used in Wilhelmi et al. (2017). For both sets of analyses we removed Evans Creek and Stone Nursery sites from the dataset as neither SNC nor Rhabdocline was observed at these sites. For the SNC analyses, all trees with less than one year of needle retention and severe Rhabdocline (over a rating of 2) were removed, as these trees could not be accurately assessed for SNC. The dataset for the Rhabdocline analyses included all live trees.


To assess the effects of foliage disease on the response variable - probability of survival (assessed in 2024), we fit models that included the assessment of fungal prevalence for either SNC or Rhabdocline, continentality (TD) climatic transfer distance between the source region and planting site, and the interaction between transfer distance and fungal prevalence. This model structure is supported by past research that suggests that where a foliage disease causing fungus is prevalent, trees with a high fungal load do not necessarily see major growth impacts, but when sources are moved, a greater fungal load can have greater effects. 


```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(glmmTMB)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(DHARMa)
library(viridis)
library(knitr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(dotwhisker)
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
# Read in data
data <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth.csv", row.names=1, na.strings="NA")

live_trees <- data %>% filter(TS==1|TS==2|TS==3) %>% 
mutate(CC_CT_comb.f = as.factor(CC_CT_comb)) %>%
  mutate(CT.f = as.factor(CT),
         CC.f = as.factor(CC)) %>%
   mutate(TopDB.f = as.factor(TopDB),
          TopDB01.f = as.factor(TopDB01))%>%
  mutate(TipDB.f = as.factor(TipDB),
         TipDB01.f = as.factor(TipDB01)) %>%
  mutate(BrDB.f = as.factor(BrDB),
         BrDB01.f = as.factor(BrDB01)) %>%
  mutate(SnkBl.f = as.factor(SnkBl),
         SnkBl01.f = as.factor(SnkBl01)) %>%
  mutate(PBl.f = as.factor(PBl),
         PBl01.f = as.factor(PBl01)) %>%
  mutate(Cankers.f = as.factor(Cankers),
         Cankers01.f = as.factor(if_else(Cankers==0, 0,
                             if_else(Cankers==1, 0, 1)))) %>%
  mutate(Gall.f = as.factor(Gall))



data_all_tmp <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE, na.strings="NA") %>%
  mutate(LD = as.numeric(if_else(TS == 1, "1",
                      if_else(TS == 2, "1",
                              if_else(TS == 3, "1","0"))))) %>%
  mutate(Site = as.factor(SITE_NAME))%>%
  mutate(LD.f = as.factor(LD))

#Combined SNC_N and SNC_S, Rhab_N and Rhab_S - where two measures exist they are averaged, 
  #otherwise the combined value is the same as the non NA measure (either N or S)

data_all_tmp %>% filter(DD=="DD") %>% group_by(SITE_NAME, REGION) %>% summarize(total_dead = sum(count))

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(MAT_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(MCMT_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(MWMT_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(MSP_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(SHM_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(MAP_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)

ggplot(data_all_tmp, aes(TD_dist, LD.f))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,alpha=0.2)
```

# Probability live in 2024
## Swiss needle cast model
### Compare alternatives

#### Data subset - initial
Uses the Wilhemi et al. filter to remove trees without second year needles and with severe Rhabdocline
```{r, include=FALSE}
tmp<-data_all_tmp %>% filter(is.na(DD)) %>%filter(!is.na(SNC_NS_15)) %>% 
  filter(Site != "StoneNursery") %>% filter(Site != "EvansCreek") %>% filter(Rhab_NS_15<2.1) %>%
  filter(NeedRet_yrs_15 >1)

#Standardized predictors 
tmp$TD_dist_std <- (tmp$TD_dist - mean(tmp$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp$TD_dist))
tmp$SNC_NS_15_std <- (tmp$SNC_NS_15 - mean(tmp$SNC_NS_15))/(2*sd(tmp$SNC_NS_15))
```

#### Data subset - alternative 1
Uses the field observed SNC values for trees without second year needles (SNC evaluated on first year needles) and with severe Rhabdocline
```{r, include=FALSE}
tmp2<-data_all_tmp %>% filter(is.na(DD)) %>%filter(!is.na(SNC_NS_15)) %>% 
  filter(Site != "StoneNursery") %>% filter(Site != "EvansCreek") # filter(Rhab_NS_15<2) %>% filter(NeedRet_yrs_15 >1)

#Standardized predictors 
tmp2$TD_dist_std <- (tmp2$TD_dist - mean(tmp2$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp2$TD_dist))
tmp2$SNC_NS_15_std <- (tmp2$SNC_NS_15 - mean(tmp2$SNC_NS_15))/(2*sd(tmp2$SNC_NS_15))
```

#### Data subset - alternative 2
Uses field observed SNC values for trees with severe Rhabdocline but simulates values for trees without second year needles. Simulated values are randomly sampled from trees with low second year needle retention (NR of 1.5 or less) and from the same Site and seed source region combination
```{r,echo=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
df <- tmp2 %>% filter(!is.na(NeedRet_yrs_15)) %>%
  group_by(SITE_NAME,REGION) %>%
  mutate(
    # Subset SNC values from trees with low second year needle retention from each Site x Seed source combo
    subset_values = list(SNC_NS_15[NeedRet_yrs_15 > 1.05&NeedRet_yrs_15 < 1.55]),
    
    # Randomly assign - with replacement - from subset 
    new_var = ifelse(
      lengths(subset_values) > 0,
      sample(unlist(subset_values), size = n(), replace = TRUE),
      NA  # If no subset values exist in group - deal with this (revise subset) if needed
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-subset_values) %>%  
  ungroup() %>%
  # final step - new value is only used for those trees with one year of needles or less, otherwise use initial field SNC value
  mutate(SNC_NS_15_sim = if_else(NeedRet_yrs_15<1.05, new_var, SNC_NS_15)) 

# View updated data
print(df)
## no NAs remain so don't need to revise the subset

#standardized coefficient for new simulated SNC value
df$SNC_NS_15_sim_std <- (df$SNC_NS_15_sim - mean(df$SNC_NS_15_sim))/(2*sd(df$SNC_NS_15_sim))
```

#### Fit and check models based on each data subset
Initial model
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Standardized predictors for interpretation and coefficient plots
modSNC.LD1 <- glmmTMB(LD ~ SNC_NS_15_std* TD_dist_std+ I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = tmp, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
 modSNC.LD1_simres <- simulateResiduals(modSNC.LD1)
 plot(modSNC.LD1_simres, sub="modSNC.LD1")
 
 #Native units for prediction plots
modSNC.LDns1 <- glmmTMB(LD ~ SNC_NS_15* TD_dist+ I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = tmp, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```

Alternative 1
```{r, echo=FALSE}

modSNC.LD2 <- glmmTMB(LD ~ SNC_NS_15_std* TD_dist_std+ I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = tmp2, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
 modSNC.LD2_simres <- simulateResiduals(modSNC.LD2)
 plot(modSNC.LD2_simres, sub="modSNC.LD2")
 
 #Native units for prediction plots
modSNC.LDns2 <- glmmTMB(LD ~ SNC_NS_15* TD_dist+ I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = tmp2, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

summary(modSNC.LD2.1) #alternative 2
```

#### Standardized coefficient plots - relative strength of model predictors
Initial model
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
LDSNC_df1 <- broom::tidy(modSNC.LD1) |> filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>filter(term != "sd__(Intercept)") |> mutate(model = "Model 1")
LDSNC1<-dwplot(LDSNC_df1)

(CoefPlot_LDSNC1<-LDSNC1 + geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x = NULL,y =NULL, title="Initial model")+
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c('SNC severity *\nContinentality', expression(paste("Continentality"^"2")),'Continentality','SNC severity'))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1.8,1.1), breaks = c(-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1))+
  geom_segment(aes(x=conf.low,y=term,xend=conf.high,
                   yend=term), colour="black", linewidth=1.2)+
  geom_point(aes(x=estimate,y=term),colour="black",size=2))
     # annotate("text", x= -1.2, y = 4.5, label = "Initial model", size=4))
```

#### Prediction plots
Probability of survival ~ continentality transfer distance at three different levels of past SNC severity
Initial model
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mydfLD_SNC1<-ggpredict(modSNC.LDns1, terms = c("TD_dist [all]", "SNC_NS_15 [1, 2, 3]"))
print(mydfLD_SNC1, n=60)

palSNC <- c ("#17A77EFF", "#82CC6CFF","#EDEF5CFF")

(pLDSNC1<-ggplot(mydfLD_SNC1, aes(x=x, y = predicted, ymin=conf.low,ymax=conf.high, colour = group, fill = group))+
    scale_color_manual("SNC\nseverity",values=palSNC, labels=c("low","moderate", "high")) +
    scale_fill_manual("SNC\nseverity",values=palSNC, labels=c("low","moderate", "high")) +
    geom_line(size=0.8)+
    theme_classic()+
    labs(x = NULL,y ="Probability of survival", title="Initial model")+
     scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0.7,1))+
   theme(legend.position=c(0.4,0.3))+
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.title = element_text(size= 10))+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size=11))+
    geom_ribbon(alpha = .1, colour = NA) )
```

### Figure 6a standardized coefficient plot
```{r,echo=FALSE}
LDSNC_df1 <- broom::tidy(modSNC.LD1) |> filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>filter(term != "sd__(Intercept)") |> mutate(model = "Model 1")
LDSNC1<-dwplot(LDSNC_df1)

(CoefPlot_LDSNC<-LDSNC1 + geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x = NULL,y =NULL)+
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c('SNC severity *\nContinentality', expression(paste("Continentality"^"2")),'Continentality','SNC severity'))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1.8,1.1), breaks = c(-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1))+
  geom_segment(aes(x=conf.low,y=term,xend=conf.high,
                   yend=term), colour="black", linewidth=1.2)+
  geom_point(aes(x=estimate,y=term),colour="black",size=2)+
      annotate("text", x= -1.2, y = 4.5, label = "Figure 6", size=4))
```

## Rhabdocline model
```{r, include=FALSE}
rhab<-data_all_tmp %>% filter(!is.na(Rhab_NS_15)) %>% filter(!is.na(LD)) %>% 
   filter(!is.na(NeedRet_yrs_15)) %>%
  filter(Site != "StoneNursery") %>% filter(Site != "EvansCreek") %>% 
  mutate(LD.f = as.factor(LD))

rhab$TD_dist_std <- (rhab$TD_dist - mean(rhab$TD_dist))/(2*sd(rhab$TD_dist))
rhab$Rhab_NS_15_std <- (rhab$Rhab_NS_15 - mean(rhab$Rhab_NS_15))/(2*sd(rhab$Rhab_NS_15))
```

### Model
```{r, include=FALSE}
#Standardized predictors for interpretation and creating Figure 6c 
modRhab.LD <- glmmTMB(LD ~ Rhab_NS_15_std* TD_dist_std+ I(TD_dist_std^2) +(1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = rhab, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
modRhab.LD_simres <- simulateResiduals(modRhab.LD)
 plot(modRhab.LD_simres, sub="modRhab.LD")#


modRhab.LD_ns <- glmmTMB(LD ~ Rhab_NS_15* TD_dist+ I(TD_dist^2) +(1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = rhab, family = binomial(link = "logit")) 

#Random effects only model to compare variance components
mod0.LD <- glmmTMB(LD ~ (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION), data = rhab, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

```

### Model results
Statistical output - reported in Tables S9 and S10
```{r, echo=FALSE}
 summary(modRhab.LD)
confint(modRhab.LD)

summary(mod0.LD)
```
